## Scope notes

Deduplex public Core focuses on Nmap/Nessus consolidate, exact dedupe, analyst queue, confirmed exports, retest hooks, and the localhost desktop Setup.

Please call out if your idea needs any of the following (often deferred or private):

- Fuzzy / root-cause merging
- Binding beyond `127.0.0.1` or multi-user auth hardening
- Laya fine-tune / GPU training / shipping torch weights (`finetune/` stays private or optional)
- Cloud / mobile / SAST connectors

## Checklist

- [ ] Not a security vulnerability (those go through SECURITY.md privately)
- [ ] No customer evidence or secrets attached
